station.name: Mean of Seoul's 25 district monitors
station.aggregation: Unweighted mean of valid hourly concentrations at the same 25 district monitors used in 2024; at least 20 monitors required per hour. Fixed monitor membership preserves the geographic definition across years. District-specific annual and seasonal completeness is audited separately. Not a population-weighted exposure estimate.

periodBasis: UTC calendar year; original local-year observations also retained in localYear

timeConvention.hour_interval_semantics: The portal describes hourly means but does not explicitly identify hour-start versus hour-end. Source labels are preserved without a one-hour shift.
timeConvention.utc_conversion: Subtract nine hours from the source local label; no daylight-saving time.
timeConvention.interpretation_limit: Exact simultaneous-hour comparisons may have a one-hour convention offset until confirmed with the provider.

quality.missingTreatment: null; retain numeric zero; no imputation or interpolation; network requires at least 20 of 25 monitors
quality.qaStatus: Archived municipal observations; final national ratification status is not supplied.
